screen: States (empty / loading / error / reported) — phone index 7, route `states`, canvas label "States"
summary: A specimen sheet of every non-happy-path surface in The Barbarian: a stale-data banner, an empty watchlist, an empty feed, a no-search-result, a loading skeleton set and a reported-post card, stacked in one scroll. In the shipped app these are six separate states belonging to six different screens — this canvas screen exists to fix their exact copy, geometry and tone, not to be built as a single page.

sections.name: Phone frame + status bar + scroll container (shared chrome, lines 46-53)
sections.description: Every screen sits in a 390x844 shell. Status bar is an absolutely-positioned overlay above the scroller (z-index 6, pointer-events:none) showing "9:41" at the start edge and three battery/signal blocks at the end edge. The screen body is a full-bleed scroller whose top padding (54px) clears the status bar and whose bottom padding (124px) clears the floating nav bar.
sections.layout: Shell: width:390px; height:844px; border-radius:46px; overflow:hidden; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#EDE8E2 0%,#E3DCD4 100%); box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(27,25,23,.20), 0 0 0 1px rgba(27,25,23,.07); position:relative. Status bar: position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:54px; z-index:6; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:0 26px; pointer-events:none; font:500 13px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#1B1917; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Battery cluster: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; three bars — 16x9px radius 2px #1B1917 opacity .85, then 5x9px radius 1px #1B1917 opacity .5, then 22x10px radius 3px #1B1917 opacity .85. Scroller: position:absolute; inset:0; overflow-y:auto; scrollbar-width:none (::-webkit-scrollbar width:0;height:0;display:none); padding:54px 16px 124px; box-sizing:border-box.

interactions: Screen enter: whole States stack runs `bRise` — 240ms ease-out, opacity 0 -> 1 with transform translateY(4px) -> translateY(0). Flutter: FadeTransition + SlideTransition (4 logical px), Curves.easeOut, 240ms.

"Browse companies" CTA: onClick = p.goMarket = go(i,'market','market') — routes the phone to the Market screen AND sets the bottom-nav selection to Market (the active pill slides from slot 0 to slot 1 with `bPill` 320ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.2,.44,1)). It also pushes the current route onto `prev` for back. cursor:pointer is the only affordance declared; there is NO hover, active or scale style on this button in the markup — pick a house press state (the canvas uses `transform:scale(0.94)` with `transition:transform 220ms ease-out` on the Pit FAB if you want a consistent one).

"Undo" text action: NO onClick is present in the design markup. Behaviour is unspecified — engineer must wire un-reporting the post and removing the card. Tap target as drawn is only ~12px tall; enlarge to >=44px without changing the visual.

Skeletons: explicitly NON-animated. The annotation reads "Static dimmed placeholders at 40% — no shimmer." Do not add a shimmer/pulse. The 40% comes from opacity:.4 on the wrapping column, so it applies to the whole skeleton group at once.
Cards (empty watchlist, empty feed, no-result, moderation) have no tap handlers and no cursor:pointer — they are not interactive surfaces.
The stale banner has no refresh affordance in this design — it is informational only.

Bottom nav (frame): 4 tabs, each flex:1 and 66px tall (good 97x66 target), onClick goHome/goMarket/goPit/goYou. Active pill animates with `bPill` (opacity 0 -> 1, 320ms, cubic-bezier(.32,1.2,.44,1)); its position is driven by translateX(0/100%/200%/300%) on a calc((100% - 12px)/4)-wide element.
Scroll: the screen scrolls under the translucent nav and the 118px bottom scrim; nothing is pinned except the status bar overlay.
flutterNotes:
STRUCTURE. Do not build this as one screen. It is a catalogue. Ship it as: (a) `StaleDataBanner` widget, (b) `EmptyStateCard` widget with optional `ghost` and `action` slots, used by the watchlist and Pit-feed screens, (c) a `NoResultsView` used under the Market search field, (d) `LoadingSkeletons` used as the initial-load body, (e) `ReportedPostCard` used in place of a hidden post in the Pit list. Keep the exact copy.

LAYOUT. Root = SingleChildScrollView(padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16,54,16,124)) inside a Stack whose top child is the status bar and whose bottom children are the nav scrim + nav bar. Root stack = Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch) with SizedBox(height:22) separators — the 22px gap is uniform, no exceptions.

TYPE. Outfit only for the two display strings ("States" 30/1.05 w300 ls -0.03em, and the 22/1.2 w300 empty-state headings). Everything else is IBM Plex Sans Arabic. CSS `font: <weight> <size>/<lineHeight>` maps to TextStyle(fontWeight, fontSize, height: <that ratio>). letter-spacing in em must be converted: .16em at 11px = 1.76 logical px (use `letterSpacing: 1.76`); -0.03em at 30px = -0.9. Set `leadingDistribution: TextLeadingDistribution.even` so the 1.5 line heights match the web box. Two eyebrow strings are stored title-case and uppercased by CSS — store them title-case and call `.toUpperCase()` only in the Latin locale (see RTL).

SHADOWS. Every card here is exactly `BoxShadow(color: Color(0x0F1B1917) /* rgba(27,25,23,.06) */, blurRadius: 24, offset: Offset(0,8))`. CSS blur 24 ≈ Flutter blurRadius 24 with spreadRadius 0; if it reads heavier, halve to 12 — but the design value is 24.

GRADIENTS / BLUR. Only the frame needs them: shell background LinearGradient(begin: topCenter, end: bottomCenter, colors:[#EDE8E2,#E3DCD4]); nav bar needs BackdropFilter(ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX:26,sigmaY:26)) — CSS 26px blur ≈ sigma 13 in Flutter (sigma ≈ radius/2), so use sigma 13 and compare; `saturate(180%)` has no direct Flutter equivalent, approximate with a ColorFilter.matrix saturation boost or drop it. Clip the BackdropFilter to the 999px capsule or the blur leaks. The nav's four box-shadows include two insets — Flutter has no inset shadow; emulate with a 1px inner Border of Color(0x4DFFFFFF) at the top plus the 1px hairline border Color(0x21FFFFFF).

NO GAUGES on this screen — the dial() arc widget is not used here, so no CustomPainter is required. The only custom paint is the 17x17 magnifier: draw it with CustomPainter (circle centre (7.2,7.2) r 5, stroke 1.5, colour #7A736D; plus a 5.4x1.5 rounded-rect handle, rx .75, rotated 45° about the point (10.6,11.3)) or ship it as an inline SVG asset. Its viewBox is 17x17 while the design nudges the circle off-centre — keep the exact coordinates, do not re-centre it.

SKELETONS. Wrap the whole skeleton Column in Opacity(opacity: 0.4) — not per-block — and use plain DecoratedBox with Color(0x1F1B1917). Explicitly no AnimatedBuilder, no shimmer package. The 96px block is radius 24; the two 64px blocks are radius 20 inside a Row with two Expanded and a 10px SizedBox between.

PRODUCT RULES. Nothing on this screen names BUY/SELL/TARGET/STOP/EXPECTED RETURN — keep it that way when you localise or expand the empty-state copy. Every state is communicated by text: the stale banner's dot is #7A736D neutral and carries no meaning, and "Under review" is a word not a colour. Do not "improve" these by adding red/green. The stale banner's age string ("2 hours ago") must be computed from the data timestamp and must never be dropped or replaced with a live-looking indicator.

RTL / ARABIC (this screen is unusually direction-sensitive for how simple it is):
- The stale banner dot leads the text — use Row with the dot first and let Directionality flip it; do not hard-code left padding.
- The search pill's magnifier must move to the right edge in Arabic, and the icon glyph itself should be mirrored (the 45° handle points down-right; wrap in Transform(scaleX: -1) under RTL) — a magnifier is conventionally mirrored in RTL.
- `padding: 0 4px` on the no-result explanation and all card paddings are symmetric, so EdgeInsets.symmetric is safe everywhere on this screen; there are no asymmetric paddings except the frame's nav (0 6px, also symmetric) and the status bar.
- "Undo" is start-aligned (default) — use TextAlign.start, never TextAlign.left.
- The centred cards (text-align:center) stay centred in both directions; no work needed.
- text-transform:uppercase + letterSpacing .16em must be DISABLED for Arabic — Arabic has no case, and positive letter spacing breaks cursive joining. Gate both on `Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.ltr` (or on locale).
- Numerals: "9:41", "2 hours ago", "0 investors", "40%" — decide Western vs Arabic-Indic digits once, app-wide, and use NumberFormat with the locale. The follower count in "You follow 0 investors." is a live number inside a sentence: make it a plural-aware ICU message, not string concatenation, because Arabic has six plural forms (0 investors / 1 / 2 / 3-10 / 11-99 / other).
- "Latest" inside the feed empty-state body is a reference to a Pit tab label — it must be translated identically to that tab, so bind it from the same string key rather than hard-coding it in the sentence.
- The query echo "zamalek holding" is user input: it can be Arabic, mixed, or long. Give the Text `overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, maxLines: 1` inside an Expanded — the design declares no overflow handling and a long query will blow the pill out.
- The em dash in "Static dimmed placeholders at 40% — no shimmer." is U+2014; that string is designer commentary, not shippable copy.

MISSING VALUES (not present in the design — do not invent, decide explicitly): pressed/hover state for "Browse companies"; the Undo tap handler and its confirmation; any focus/accessibility labels; dark-mode variants (the canvas header says "dark-first" but the States screen is drawn light only); semantics/screen-reader strings; and the exact width of the stale banner (it stretches, no max-width is declared).
